title: La Reina: contexto territorial y comunidad
purpose: Muestra audiovisual de contexto para probar el panorama continuo de las paredes del gemelo digital; no exhibe datos duros.
source_type: Photographs published by Municipalidad de La Reina and official Parque Padre Hurtado website. No generative images.
composition: Six separate contextual photographs arranged left-to-right with approximately 160px smoothstep alpha overlaps. Cropped without geometric stretching. No charts, captions, frames, graphic borders, or invented catastrophes. The montage is illustrative, not a stitched photograph of one continuous viewpoint.
animation: Each photographic crop shifts only 6px sinusoidally over 8s. Periodic motion returns to identical state at t=8 for a seamless loop.
palette_note: Photographs preserve natural colors. No recoloring; graphic identity is applied elsewhere in room materials and guidance.
